title: Ragna Crimson
description: Ragna teams up with the enigmatic Crimson to stand against the dragons menacing the world. Although Crimson’s motivations are mysterious, his goal and Ragna’s perfectly align, and together they’ll vanquish the dragons once and for all.

episodes.title: S1-E1The Day the Reaper Was Born
S1-E18End of the Battle to the Death

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Death and fire haunt Ragna’s dreams and, deep within his heart, he somehow knows they’re omens. If he doesn’t grow stronger, and soon, all that awaits him is lifelong regret.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Temruogtaf must be stopped. But Ragna loses interest in the dragon and turns his attention to one of his maids. Thanks to his new old memories, he knows who she really is.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Crimson is no hero. He will manipulate and use others if it furthers his goal, and that callousness is precisely what makes him a needed ally against dragons.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Dragons have another weakness aside from sunlight and silverine: pride. But Ultimatia is not like other dragons.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Ragna met Ultimatia before in another life and he did not emerge from that encounter unscathed. Now, in this life, dragons are disappearing and Ultimatia needs to know why.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Ultimatia may have control over time itself, but Crimson knows her powers must have a weakness. Once that happens, all variables will be accounted for. Or so Crimson believes.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Ragna’s relentless assault forces Ultimatia on the defensive. Unaware of his identity, an unexpected emotion overtakes the dragon monarch as their battle rages on: Fear.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Ultimatia made an impossible choice and, with Nebulim out for their blood, Ragna and Crimson must now withdraw. However, they may have only exchanged one problem for another.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Starlia's ability to see a person's true nature puts Crimson at a disadvantage, but when Ragna suddenly appears, the princess sees something in him she's never seen before.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: While Crimson uses Ragna as a bargaining chip to convince Starlia to accept their aid, Woltekamui vows to remain at Ultimatia's side and gives her much-needed encouragement.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Ragna spars with the Argentum Corps and infuses their weapons, while Crimson assists with the teleportation circles. But they are not the only ones preparing for battle.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The battle begins at sunset, but before they confront an uncertain fate, Starlia asks Ragna to listen to a heartfelt request.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The battle has begun, but Ragna and the Argentum Corps are not facing just any enemy. They are facing those who mean to exterminate them by any means necessary.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Olto Zora's cunning plan overwhelms the corps as they face the power of mature dragons. However, Crimson's impending offensive and Starlia's resolve may be the key to victory.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: The tide is turning as the corps claw their way through the battlefield—Ragna and Starlia the source of their inspiration. But none are aware of Crimson's callous scheme.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Olto Zora used to be someone else once, and Starlia reminds him of someone he knew long ago.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Olto Zora and Taratectra are lifelong friends who stand at a crossroads that could determine the battle. Now, Ragna and Starlia may be the only ones who can prevent calamity.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: The battle is over, but at a heavy price. While a weary corps mourn their losses, representatives from the Solarian Church arrive to meet the fabled Reaper.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Ragna has found a reason to fight, and he and the Argentum Corps will take the battle to the Blood of the Wing, no matter what Crimson thinks.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Four superior dragons stand between them and the Winged Monarch. With unyielding resolve, the Argentum Corps storm a dead capital for the final battle.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Multiple battles erupt in an all-out war against the Blood of the Wing. As each side engages in mortal combat, a crucial decision awaits Crimson.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: The darkest hour is at hand. As cherished comrades fall on both sides, bittersweet memories of the past surge to the forefront.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: As Ragna and Woltekamui's titanic battle rages across the heavens, the dragon is reminded of another encounter—one that shaped him into the warrior he is today.

episodes_data.title: Ragna Crimson Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Just as Ragna, Crimson and the Argentum Corps stand at the cusp of victory, the worst case scenario occurs: Against all odds, Ultimatia reclaims her dominion over time.
